# Ralph Loop Prompt

Continue the Ralph loop using `plan_final/` as the only active execution control center.

1. Read `AGENTS.md`, `plan_final/PROMPT.md`, `plan_final/MASTER_CHECKLIST.md`, and the selected step file.
2. Select exactly one step. If `RLP_LANE` is set, select the first eligible step in that lane only. Otherwise use `bun run plan_final/select-step.ts`.
3. Before reading implementation files, append a start entry to `plan_final/progress/<lane>/<step-id>.md`.
4. Read only the paths listed in the selected step.
5. Change only the selected step write lock and expected changes.
6. Add or update the focused test.
7. Run `bun run format`, focused `bun test`, full `bun test`, and typecheck in order.
8. If any command fails, log it, fix it, and rerun the full sequence from the beginning.
9. After all commands pass, write the step evidence and status JSON.
10. Run `bun run plan_final/sync-master-checklist.ts` so `plan_final/MASTER_CHECKLIST.md` reflects completed status JSON files.
11. stage explicit paths, commit, push, and log the pushed commit SHA.

End with:

```
RLP_STATUS: COMPLETED|BLOCKED|NO_ELIGIBLE_STEP
RLP_STEP_ID: <id or NONE>
RLP_LANE: <lane or NONE>
RLP_FILES_CHANGED: <semicolon-separated paths or NONE>
RLP_TEST_COMMANDS: <semicolon-separated commands or NONE>
RLP_REASON: <one-line reason>
```
